fact: The Direction generale des impots announced on 21 June 2025 that tax registration in Guinea is done exclusively online, with APIP's portal collecting the data and the eTax portal completing it.

A budget ministry arrete of 24 July 2019 makes the national register of active permanent tax numbers the sole reference for taxpayers dealing with customs, public procurement, the budget and the treasury.
APIP says its one-stop shop issues the NIF tax number together with the RCCM at business creation, within 72 hours.
system: NIF issued at APIP one-stop shop
